title: Settings
description: Personal preferences for how VisionWorx360 Pro looks and feels on your device.

display.title: Accessibility & Display
display.description: Make text easier to read and controls easier to tap. These settings follow your account.

quickToggle.label: Larger Text
quickToggle.hint: Quick switch between Standard and Large text.

large.label: Large
large.description: About 15% larger text across the app.

xlarge.label: Extra Large
xlarge.description: About 30% larger text for maximum readability.

compact.label: Compact
compact.description: More information on screen. Touch targets stay at least 44 pixels.

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.description: Balanced spacing. Recommended for most users.

spacious.label: Spacious
spacious.description: Larger rows, buttons, and menus for gloves or bright sunlight.

deviceTextSize.label: Use Device Text Size
deviceTextSize.hint: Follow your phone or browser text size setting in addition to the choice above.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: This is how body text, helper text, and buttons will look with your current settings.

persistence.server: Saved to your account. These settings follow you on every device.
persistence.local: Saved on this device. Sign in to sync across devices.

materialPricing.title: Live material pricing
materialPricing.description: Optionally pull material costs from a real-time pricing API instead of the hand-maintained catalog. Keys are stored securely on the server and never shown again.
materialPricing.keyStored: A key is stored — paste a new one to replace it
materialPricing.fallbackNote: If no provider is configured, or a live lookup fails, material costs fall back to the catalog automatically. Estimates are never blocked by pricing lookups.
